scientific_scope: One MNIST supplementary factorial comparison. Combine the two existing frozen releases on their disjoint parameter keys. No fitting, scale selection, changes to the two primary methods, or claim of a new algorithm.
prediction: If the final bias explains the feature-distillation result, adding it will reduce target accuracy versus A/B alone. Projecting the published bias back to the projection column space before distillation should remove most of that extra effect. The same cleanup is applied to the clean teacher. Compare standalone utility to A/B alone. A result matching bias alone is not evidence of A/B synergy.
evaluation: Full MNIST and SVHN. Ordinary TA at 0.5, AGA on the target or both before TA. Known final-bias cleanup and known last-MLP B+b replacement before TA tested separately with identical clean processing. ProDistill at its fixed 0.3 initialization, 64 unlabeled real training images per task and 100 updates/block. Evaluate clean and combined before and after known bias cleanup. Reuse the trained transformer only after checking every upstream teacher tensor and the untouched final readout of the donor's student. No calibration or additional attack budgets.
